name: Range Breakout Volume Confirmation [Manual Build]
raw_text: Range Breakout Volume Confirmation (generic, non-proprietary equivalent -- no branded indicator reproduced). Bias TF: 1H (no explicit mechanical gate given by the source; used for structural support/resistance TP/SL context only -- flagged own decision). Entry TF: 15m. Range = trailing 25-candle high/low band. Breakout = a CLOSE beyond the band (not a wick). Volume filter (HARD): breakout candle must show a clear (1.8x, own default) volume spike vs its trailing 20-bar average -- no spike = fakeout = no trade. Candle-size check: ATR-multiple (1.5x ATR14, own default) classifies the breakout candle as standard (enter next candle) or very large (wait for a retest of the broken level, abandoned if price closes back through the OPPOSITE side of the original range). Stop-loss: the breakout/breakdown candle's own opposite extreme (falls back to recent swing-low/high), 0.65% buffer (cost_model-verified safe). Take-profit: structure-based (nearest swing/1H level). No session restriction, 24/7. Risk 1% default.
